name: How long does it take to get a storm-related roof condition report?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a storm-related roof condition report?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to complete a storm-related roof condition report typically depends on the size and accessibility of your roof, as well as the extent of visible damage. Most on-site inspections can be completed within 30 minutes to an hour. Following the inspection, the full written report with photographs is usually prepared and delivered within 24-48 hours. Factors such as inclement weather or high demand after a major storm can occasionally extend these timelines. We strive to provide timely reports to help you move forward with your insurance claim as quickly as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: On-site inspections usually take 30-60 minutes, with the full report delivered within 24-48 hours, though timing can vary after major storms.
